description: Implement the mandatory per-Step Single Step Publication Specialization: concrete ReservationGrant, PublicationAcknowledgement, PublicationStatus, PublicationRejection, ReleaseAcknowledgement representations; named Step-owned Recovery Owner and recovery procedure; identity generation/uniqueness/stability/retirement rules; publication-status record retention/tombstone/expiry; end-to-end state and custody trace. Ensures no-fail ownership transfer boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: Concrete publication protocol representations defined per Step
No-fail final ownership-transfer strategy for THandlingOperationResult and ErrorHandlingOperationEntry
Named Step-owned Recovery Owner with recovery procedure for contract violation/indeterminate acceptance
Identity generation, uniqueness, stability, retirement, reuse rules defined
Publication-status retention, tombstone, expiry rules defined
End-to-end state and custody trace covering all branches
Exception/missing acknowledgement never treated as proof of rejection
definitionOfDone: Idempotent retry tests (same logical entry, consumed reservation)
Architecture test: TBD not permitted for required specializations
testStrategy: Publication protocol tests; recovery/custody tests; idempotent retry tests; ambiguous outcome tests
